Dusklight can automatically send crash reports to the developers. Crash reports contain the following:
• Operating system version
• CPU architecture
• GPU model & driver version
• File paths (may include account username)
• Stack trace

Adjusts the volume of all sounds in the game.
Allow controller input even when the game window is not focused.
Allows Wolf Link to howl and change the time of day.
Always collect Rupees even if your Wallet is too full.
Autosaves the game when going to a new area, opening a dungeon door, or getting a new item.

Connect to LiveSplit server on localhost:16834. For this to work you must right click LiveSplit, and turn on Control -> Start TCP Server. To see IGT in LiveSplit you must change your comparison to Game Time.
Disable black bars on the left and right sides of the screen during some cutscenes, particularly on ultra-wide displays. Visuals beyond the original intended framing may appear buggy.
Disable the beeping sound when having low health.

Disables the elements of the main HUD of the game.
Useful for a more immersive experience.
Display the current framerate in a corner of the screen while playing.
Displays collected/total number of Poe Souls for a region on the map.
Display the RTA timer. IGT is always visible.
Emulate surround sound via HRTF. Recommended only for use with headphones!
Enables gyro controls for Rollgoal in Hena's Cabin.

Enables gyro controls while in look mode, aiming a hawk, and aiming supported items.
Supported items include the Slingshot, Gale Boomerang, Hero's Bow, Clawshot(s), Ball and Chain, and Dominion Rod.
Enables rotating Link in the collection menu with the C-Stick.
Enables speedrunning options while restricting certain gameplay modifiers.
Enables the reverb effect in game audio.
Enables twin-stick camera control, letting the C-Stick move the camera vertically as well as horizontally.
Invert horizontal movement while flying or swimming.
Invert vertical movement while flying or swimming.
Hearts will never drop from enemies, pots, and various other places.
Hold Tab to increase game speed by up to 4x.
Hold the indicated button to mash automatically.
Ignores small gyro movement to reduce drift and jitter.
Invert horizontal movement while aiming with items or first person camera. Applies only to the control stick (the gyroscope can be inverted in Input settings).
Invert vertical camera movement when Free Camera is enabled.
Invert vertical movement while aiming with items or first person camera. Applies only to the control stick (the gyroscope can be inverted in Input settings).
Link will not recoil when his sword hits walls.
Lock the game's aspect ratio to the original.
Makes text scroll immediately by holding B.
Mirrors the world horizontally, matching the Wii version of the game.
Removes completed Owl Statue markers from the map and Minimap.
Render a blurring effect for out-of-focus areas in some situations. May impact performance.
Render a thick shadow around the mini-map. May impact performance.
Pause the game when window focus is lost.
Play sound effects when navigating the Dusklight menu.
Prevents enemy music while Midna's Lament is playing.
Prevents Link from playing a struggle animation when grabbing ledges or climbing on vines.
Quicker climbing on ladders and vines like the HD version.
Reduces how long the transitions take when changing maps.
Restores all binding configurations for the currently selected device to their defaults.
Restores patched glitches from Wii USA 1.0, the first released version.
Rupees will not play cutscenes after you have collected them the first time.

Sensor reads motion directly from a supported controller's gyro via SDL.
Mouse treats mouse input as gyro, intended for use with the Steam Deck.
Mouse input cannot currently be used with Gyro Rollgoal.
Shows the aiming reticle for bow and slingshot.
Skip needing to catch a second fish for Sera's cat.
Skips the delay when writing to the Memory Card.
Synchronizes the frame rate to your monitor's refresh rate.
Tears of Light dropped by Shadow Insects pop out faster like the HD version.
Transform instantly by pressing R and Y simultaneously.
Changes how the Collection and File Select menus scale to your aspect ratio.
Limit the framerate to the specified value.
Wallet sizes are like in the HD version. (500, 1000, 2000)
Any hit will instantly kill you.
Controls how strongly gyro input tilts the Rollgoal table.
Configure the sampling method used when scaling the internal resolution for final presentation.
Higher values smooth gyro input over time.
Keeps your underwater oxygen meter full.
Item drops such as rupees and hearts will never disappear after they drop.
Hold R and A to rise into the air.
Hold R to always do a Quick Spin when attacking with B.
Extends Clawshot behavior beyond the normal game rules.
Allows the Great Spin attack without requiring full health.
Speeds up movement while wearing the Iron Boots.
Allows transforming even if NPCs are looking.
Makes Link's roll animation and movement twice as fast.
Speeds up Spinner movement while holding R.
Lets the magic armor work without consuming rupees.
Replaces the name entry keyboard with common Chinese characters.
Choose a preset to get started. You can change any setting later from the Settings menu.
Enhancements disabled to match the GameCube version. Good for speedrunning or simple nostalgia!
Graphics & quality of life tweaks, including some from the Wii U version. Our recommended way to play!

Dusklight can automatically send crash reports to the developers. Crash reports contain the following:
• Operating system version
• CPU architecture
• GPU model & driver version
• File paths (may include account username)
• Stack trace
This can be changed in the Settings menu at any time.
Send crash reports to Dusklight developers. Reports will include the information described above.
Do not send crash reports. This may make it more difficult to resolve issues you encounter.
Enable Dusk to integrate with Discord Rich Presence. This allows Discord to show your status in-game.

Show advanced settings and debugging tools with Shift+F1.
WARNING: Debugging tools can easily break your game. Do not use on a regular save!
Display a controller input overlay while playing.
Show gyro sensor values in the input viewer.
Skips the TV calibration screen shown when loading a save.

Disables the game HUD and all background music.
Useful for recording footage.

Configure the resolution used for rendering the game. Higher values are more demanding on your graphics hardware.
Configure the shadow-map resolution. Higher values improve shadow quality but increase GPU and memory usage.

Invert vertical mouse control for both aiming and camera.
Scales the size of the gameplay HUD, including hearts, buttons, and the mini-map. Does not affect menus.

Enables controls overlay for touch screens.
Press and drag on the left side of the screen to move, and on the right side of the screen to control the camera.

Applies to touch input only.
